segments.name: Banking
segments.description: A community bank providing diversified financial services to commercial, retail, governmental, educational, energy, health care and real estate customers across the Southeast.
segments.evidence: We provide a wide range of financial products and services to the commercial, retail, governmental, educational, energy, health care and real estate sectors.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest on loans to individuals and businesses, funded primarily by customer deposits, plus fee income from mortgage origination, loan servicing, wealth management, insurance and payment processing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Deposits are the major source of our funds for lending and other investment activities.

changes.text: In 2025, the company completed the acquisition of ANB, a Florida bank, adding loans and deposits in the Fort Lauderdale metropolitan area.
changes.evidence: On May 1, 2025, we completed the acquisition of ANB, headquartered in Oakland Park, Florida where it operated one banking location in the Fort Lauderdale metropolitan area.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold FinTrust, its wealth management business, incurring a loss.
changes.evidence: Other noninterest expense decreased for 2025 as the 2024 comparative period included a $5.39 million loss on the sale of FinTrust.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold substantially all of its manufactured housing loan portfolio.
changes.evidence: In addition, during 2024, we sold $303 million of manufactured housing loans, substantially all of that portfolio, which resulted in a $27.2 million loss.
